records.text: On 2023-05-07, Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group and found the experience powerful. Caroline was inspired by transgender stories and felt happy and thankful for the support.
Caroline said the LGBTQ support group helped her feel accepted and gave her courage to embrace herself.
Caroline shared a photo showing a dog walking past a wall painted with an image of a woman.

Caroline plans to continue her education and explore career options. She is especially interested in counseling or working in mental health because she would like to support people with similar issues.
Melanie said she was swamped with her children and work.
Melanie shared a photo of a painting depicting a sunset over a lake. Caroline complimented it and asked whether Melanie had painted it; the conversation does not establish who painted it.
Melanie painted the lake sunrise painting in 2022 and said it was special to her.
Caroline complimented the colors in Melanie's lake sunrise painting, saying they blended nicely, and described painting as a great outlet for self-expression.
Melanie said painting is a fun way for her to express her feelings and be creative, and that painting helps her relax after a long day.
Caroline said she was going to do some research; she did not specify the research topic.
Melanie said she was going swimming with her children and planned to talk with Caroline soon.
On 2023-05-20, Melanie ran in a charity race for mental health. Melanie found the race rewarding and thought-provoking, and it prompted her to reflect on caring for mental health.
Melanie is realizing that self-care is important. Melanie says that looking after herself helps her better care for her family, and that prioritizing self-care is a journey and work in progress.
Melanie is making time for herself each day by running, reading, or playing her violin. Melanie says these activities refresh her and help her stay present for her family.
Melanie has children who are excited about summer break.
Melanie and her family are thinking about going camping in June 2023; the trip is tentative.
Caroline told Melanie she was proud of her for participating in the mental health charity race and praised Melanie for prioritizing self-care and caring for her family.
On 2023-05-25, Caroline was researching adoption agencies. Caroline said having a family and giving a loving home to children who need it had been a dream of hers.
On 2023-05-25, Melanie praised Caroline for considering taking in children in need, called Caroline kind, and said Caroline’s future family would be lucky to have her.

On 2023-05-25, Caroline said her goal was to give children a loving home. Caroline expressed gratitude for support from friends and mentors and said the hard work of making her dream a reality was beginning. Caroline felt hopeful and optimistic, though she found the process a lot to take in.
On 2023-05-25, Caroline shared a photo while researching an adoption agency. The photo showed a sign for a new arrival and an information and domestic building.
On 2023-05-25, Caroline said she chose an adoption agency because it helps LGBTQ+ people with adoption; the agency’s inclusivity and support appealed to her. The agency’s name was not stated.
On 2023-05-25, Melanie praised the adoption agency Caroline had selected and asked what Caroline was excited about in the adoption process; Caroline’s answer is not included in this segment.

On 2023-05-25, Caroline said she was thrilled to build a family for children who need one through adoption. She expects single parenting to be tough but is ready for the challenge and intends to give the children a safe, loving home.

On 2023-05-25, Melanie praised Caroline's plan to create a family for children in need, said Caroline would be an awesome mother, and expressed confidence that Caroline's caring heart would provide the children love and stability. Melanie wished Caroline good luck and said she was excited for Caroline's new chapter.

Caroline and Melanie are friends or acquaintances who address each other by name; Caroline calls Melanie “Mel.” Caroline values support from an LGBTQ support group and is considering counseling or mental-health work. Caroline dreams of adopting children in need and giving them a loving home. On 2023-05-25, Caroline said she chose an agency that helps LGBTQ+ people adopt because of its inclusivity and support; the agency name is unknown. Caroline is thrilled to build a family through adoption, recognizes single parenting will be tough, and is ready for the challenge. She intends to provide the children a safe, loving home. Melanie encouraged Caroline, predicted she would be an awesome mother, and said her caring heart would give the children love and stability. Melanie has children and is busy with work. On 2023-05-08, Caroline shared a photo of a dog passing a wall painting of a woman; Melanie shared a special lake sunrise painting she made in 2022.

During the week before June 9, 2023, Caroline spoke at a school event about her transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community. She discussed her struggles and growth since coming out, and said the audience related to her story and was inspired to become better allies.
On June 9, 2023, Caroline said she had started transitioning about three years earlier, around 2020.

Caroline felt powerful while giving her school talk and believes conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary. She sees sharing personal stories as important for promoting understanding and acceptance and giving hope to others.
Caroline said she had received much love and support during her transition and wanted to pass that support on to others by using her voice to create a more inclusive and understanding world.
On June 9, 2023, Caroline said her friends, family, and mentors were her rocks and motivated her, giving her strength to keep going.
On June 9, 2023, Melanie said her family motivated her and gave her love, and that she wanted to be courageous for them.

On June 9, 2023, Caroline shared a photo described as showing a family posing for a picture in a yard, saying it was from when they had met up the previous week. The people in the photo were not identified.

On June 9, 2023, Caroline and Melanie exchanged encouragement and expressed a desire to keep motivating and helping each other through life's challenges. Melanie said she was proud to be part of the difference Caroline was making.

On 2023-06-09, Caroline said she had known her supportive friends for four years, since she moved from her home country. Caroline said her friends had been there through everything and that their love and help were especially important after a difficult breakup.
On 2023-06-09, Melanie said her husband and children support her and keep her motivated. Melanie shared a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall.
On 2023-06-09, Melanie said she and her husband had been married for five years. Melanie shared a photo of herself as a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet.
On 2023-06-09, Melanie said her family and the moments they share make everything worthwhile. Melanie said she cherishes time with her family and feels most alive and happy during those moments.
On 2023-06-09, Melanie shared a photo of a man and a woman sitting on a blanket and eating food. Melanie said the outing was fun: they played games, ate good food, and spent time together.
On 2023-06-09, Caroline said spending time with loved ones brings happiness and gratitude, and agreed with Melanie that family moments are important.
On 2023-06-27, Caroline shared a photo of a person holding a necklace with a cross and a heart.

Caroline's grandmother gave Caroline a necklace with a cross and a heart when Caroline was young. Caroline's grandmother is from Sweden, Caroline's home country. Caroline says the necklace represents love, faith, and strength, and reminds Caroline of her roots and the love and support Caroline gets from family.
On 2023-06-27, Melanie shared a photo of a stack of bowls with different designs.

Caroline treasures a hand-painted bowl made by a friend as a gift for Caroline's 18th birthday, about ten years before 2023. Caroline likes its pattern and colors, and says it reminds Caroline of art and self-expression.

Melanie took her family camping in the mountains during the week of 2023-06-19 through 2023-06-25. They explored nature, roasted marshmallows around a campfire, and hiked; Melanie said the view from the top was amazing. Melanie said her two younger children love nature and that the family time was special and memorable.
Melanie says family time matters to her.

On 2023-06-27, Caroline said she had recently been looking into counseling and mental health as a career, wanting to help people who had gone through experiences similar to hers. Caroline was still figuring out the details and was considering working with trans people to support their self-acceptance and mental health.

On 2023-06-23, Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop that she found enlightening. The workshop covered different therapeutic methods and how to work effectively with trans people. Caroline was impressed by the professionals' passion for creating a safe space for people like her.

Caroline said her own journey and the support she received made a major difference in her life. Counseling and support groups improved her life, helped her understand herself, and led her to care more about mental health. Caroline wants to create a safe, inviting place where people can grow and receive support.

Melanie praised Caroline's dedication to helping others, called her work impressive and inspiring, and encouraged her to continue. Melanie also congratulated Caroline for pursuing what she cares about.
On 2023-06-27, Caroline shared a photo of a bookshelf with many books on it. Melanie shared a photo of a bookshelf filled with books in a room.
Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ pride parade during the week of 2023-06-26 to 2023-07-02. The happy atmosphere made Caroline feel that she belonged and showed her how much the LGBTQ+ community had grown.
After attending the LGBTQ+ pride parade, Caroline felt motivated to use her personal story to help others and remained interested in pursuing counseling and mental-health work.

Melanie signed up for a pottery class on 2023-07-02. Melanie finds pottery calming and says it helps her express emotions and brings her joy; she considers pottery a major part of her life, not merely a hobby.
Melanie shared a photo of a person holding a frisbee. The conversation does not identify the person in the photo.

Melanie made a bowl in her pottery class featuring a black-and-white flower design. Melanie said making the bowl took work and expressed pride in it; Caroline complimented its design and Melanie's creativity.
Caroline was learning to play the piano and described herself as getting creative too.
Caroline planned to attend a transgender conference in July 2023. She was excited to meet other people in the community and learn more about advocacy, and said she would update Melanie afterward.

On 2023-07-06, Caroline told Melanie that she had been looking further into counseling or mental-health work. Caroline said she was passionate about helping people and making a positive impact, and that the work seemed tough but rewarding.
On 2023-07-05, Melanie took her children to a museum and enjoyed spending time with them and seeing their excitement. Melanie shared a photograph showing two children playing in a water-play area.
On 2023-07-06, Caroline complimented the photograph Melanie shared of her two children playing in a museum water-play area and asked what had excited them.

On 2023-07-06, Melanie said her children were excited about a dinosaur exhibit, loved learning about animals, and thought the bones were very cool. Seeing their enthusiasm reminded Melanie why she loves being a mother.

On 2023-07-06, Caroline said she was creating a library for her future children and looked forward to reading to them and opening their minds. Caroline shared a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys.
On 2023-07-06, Caroline described her future children's library as containing many children's books, including classics, stories from different cultures, and educational books.

Melanie said her favorite childhood book was "Charlotte's Web" because it showed how friendship and compassion can make a difference. Melanie shared a photo of a book cover depicting a girl and a cat.
During the week of 2023-06-29 to 2023-07-05, Caroline had a picnic with friends and shared a photo showing a group of women sitting together on a blanket in a park.

Caroline said her friends and family have supported her transition at every step with love, guidance, acceptance, encouragement, and unconditional love. She said their support helped her accept and grow into her true self and was instrumental in her transition.
Melanie shared a photo of her family sitting around a campfire on a beach while camping. Melanie said her family loves camping there because it brings them closer.

On 2023-07-10, Caroline attended an LGBTQ+ conference where she met and connected with people who had similar journeys. Caroline found the environment welcoming and felt totally accepted; the conference strengthened her appreciation for the LGBTQ+ community and the importance of fighting for trans rights and spreading awareness.
Caroline believes LGBTQ+ rights have advanced significantly, but that more progress is still needed, and she wants to help make a difference.
As of 2023-07-12, Caroline was looking into counseling and mental-health jobs because she wants people to have someone they can talk to and wants to help make that support available.

Caroline has struggled with mental health and found the support she received very helpful. That experience led her to explore counseling and mental-health careers so she could support other people on their journeys, as others supported her.

On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photograph of a book cover featuring a gold coin. Caroline said seeing the picture renewed her appreciation of reading; she finds books guide and motivate her and help her discover who she is.
Caroline loves reading and describes books as an important part of her personal journey because they guide, motivate, and help her understand herself.

Caroline's favorite guiding book is “Becoming Nicole” by Amy Ellis Nutt, a true story about a transgender girl and her family. Caroline found the book inspiring, felt connected to it, and gained hope for her own path; she recommended it to Melanie.
Caroline said “Becoming Nicole” taught her self-acceptance and how to find support, and showed her that difficult times do not last and that hope and love exist. Caroline also said pets bring joy.
During their 2023-07-12 conversation, Caroline shared a photograph of a dog sitting in a boat on the water. Melanie later shared a photograph of two little girls sitting on steps with a dog.
Melanie agreed with Caroline that pets bring joy and comfort, and said that self-acceptance and finding support are important.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie said her household has a dog and a cat. Melanie did not provide either pet’s name.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared a photo of a cat lying on the floor with its head on the floor.
On 2023-07-12, Caroline called Melanie’s dog and cat adorable and said pets bring people a lot of joy.
On 2023-07-12, Melanie said Luna and Oliver were sweet and playful and livened up her house. The conversation does not specify which animal each name belongs to.

On 2023-07-12, Melanie shared photos of pink running shoes: one showed a person wearing pink sneakers on a white rug, and another showed a pair of pink sneakers in a box. Caroline remarked on the shoes’ purple color and asked whether they were for walking or running; Melanie said they were for running.

By 2023-07-12, Melanie had been running longer and farther than at the time of her previous chat with Caroline. Melanie said running helped her destress, clear her mind, and improve her mental health and headspace; she intended to continue. Caroline encouraged Melanie to keep running and prioritize self-care.

On 2023-07-14, Melanie took her children to a pottery workshop. Melanie and the children each made pots, and Melanie described the activity as fun and therapeutic. A shared photo showed children making clay sculptures in a classroom.
Melanie's children loved the pottery workshop and enjoyed getting their hands dirty and making things with clay. They made a cup decorated with a dog face; Melanie shared a photo of it.
Melanie and her children have recently enjoyed painting together, especially nature-inspired pictures. They both helped make a painting of a sunset with a palm tree, shown in a shared photo.

While spending time together painting and talking about nature, Melanie and her children found a field of purple flowers with green leaves. Melanie shared a photo of the flowers and said they appreciated the small things in life.

On 2023-07-14, Caroline attended a council meeting about adoption. Caroline found it inspiring and emotional to see many people wanting to create loving homes for children in need, and the meeting strengthened her determination to adopt.
Melanie encouraged Caroline about her adoption plans, saying Caroline's future family would be lucky to have her.
Melanie shared a photo of a blue vase holding a bouquet of sunflowers and roses.
Caroline said blue is her favorite color and that it makes her feel relaxed. She asked about flower symbolism, mentioning that sunflowers mean warmth and happiness and roses mean love and beauty.

Melanie said flowers bring her joy and represent growth, beauty, and appreciating small moments. Flowers were an important part of Melanie’s wedding decor and remind her of her wedding day. Melanie shared a photo of white chairs decorated with flowers.

Melanie described her wedding as amazing and full of love and joy, with everyone she and her partner loved present to celebrate. She shared a photo of the ceremony in a greenhouse, with people taking pictures. Melanie said the best part was marrying her partner and promising to be together forever; she shared a photo of a man and woman standing on a beach.

Caroline attended and joined a pride parade a few weeks before 2023-07-15. She described it as amazing and one of her best memories: she felt accepted, happy, proud, grateful, comforted that she was not alone, and supported by a great community. She said the loving, accepting atmosphere and people embracing and backing her inspired her. Caroline shared photos of the street parade, smiling people holding signs, and a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet.

Caroline said the best part of her journey was realizing she could be herself without fear and finding the courage to transition. She finds it freeing to express herself authentically and have people support her. Caroline said the road had been long and that she was proud of how far she had come. Melanie affirmed that being oneself matters for mental health and peace. Caroline shared photos of a group sitting on the ground with a dog and a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows; Melanie shared a photo of a Buddha statue and candle.

Melanie said creativity and family help her find peace. She said her family supported her during her move by helping and showing love and support, and that their support helped her through tough times. Melanie mentioned that her family had gone on another camping trip in the forest and shared a photo of a man and two children sitting around a campfire. She also shared a photo of a man holding a frisbee in front of a disc-golf basket.

Caroline and Melanie are friends or acquaintances who address each other by name. Caroline calls Melanie “Mel,” “Mell,” and “Caro” is Melanie’s nickname for Caroline. Caroline values LGBTQ+ support and is exploring counseling or mental-health work, especially supporting trans people; counseling, her journey, and support groups improved her life and self-understanding. Caroline is researching adoption and dreams of giving children in need a loving home; on 2023-05-25 she chose an unnamed agency for LGBTQ+ inclusivity and support. On 2023-07-14 Caroline attended an inspiring, emotional adoption council meeting and felt more determined to adopt. Melanie has children, is busy with work, has a dog and a cat, and has a partner whom she married. On 2023-07-15, Melanie said flowers were important to her wedding decor; her wedding ceremony was in a greenhouse and she described marrying her partner as its best part. Caroline attended a pride parade around late June/early July 2023 and felt accepted, proud, grateful, and supported. Caroline said transitioning helped her express herself authentically without fear. Melanie said creativity and family bring her peace; her family supported her during a move and went camping in the forest.
Melanie and her family enjoy hiking in the mountains and exploring forests together. Melanie described these outings as favorite memories that bring her family together and make them happy.

Caroline and Melanie value their friendship and support for one another. Caroline said she was glad to have Melanie as a friend with whom to share her journey; Melanie appreciated Caroline's friendship and called her a supporter. Caroline said Melanie's friendship meant a great deal to her.

Melanie said she had a quiet weekend on July 15–16, 2023, after camping with her family and children two weekends earlier, around July 1–2. Melanie said the camping trip was great and let her unplug and spend time with her children.
Caroline said she joined a mentorship program for LGBTQ youth during the weekend of July 15–16, 2023, and found it rewarding to help the community.
Caroline said her LGBTQ youth mentoring was going well. She had met amazing young people, supported them, and found their resilience and strength inspiring.

Caroline mentors a transgender teenager who is like Caroline. They have been working on building the teenager's confidence and finding positive strategies, and Caroline said their efforts were paying off.

Caroline and her transgender mentee attended an LGBT Pride event in June 2023. Caroline described the event as awesome and encouraging because they were surrounded by love and acceptance. Caroline shared a photo showing a woman holding a rainbow umbrella in the air.
Caroline said the most memorable part of the Pride event was seeing her mentee's face light up upon seeing the support; Caroline described it as a special moment.

Caroline and Melanie are friends or acquaintances who address each other by name; Caroline calls Melanie “Mel” (and once “Mell”). They value their friendship and mutual support. Caroline values LGBTQ+ support and is exploring counseling or mental-health work, especially supporting trans people, to help people with experiences like hers and create a safe, inviting space. Counseling, her journey, and support groups improved Caroline’s life and self-understanding. Caroline is researching adoption and dreams of giving children in need a loving home; on 2023-05-25 she chose an unnamed agency for LGBTQ+ inclusivity and support. On 2023-07-14 Caroline attended an inspiring, emotional adoption council meeting and felt more determined to adopt. Melanie has children, is busy with work, and has a dog. In July 2023 Caroline joined an LGBTQ youth mentorship program and mentors a transgender teen like herself. They worked on confidence and positive strategies and attended an LGBT Pride event in June 2023; Caroline shared a photo of a woman holding a rainbow umbrella. Caroline was moved by her mentee's happiness at seeing the support.
Caroline is having an LGBTQ+ art show featuring her paintings in August 2023 and is excited about it.
During a conversation on July 17, 2023, Melanie shared a photo of a painting with a blue-and-yellow design while asking Caroline for a preview of her art for the upcoming LGBTQ+ art show.
Caroline shared a photo of her painting for the upcoming art show. The painting depicts a tree with a bright sun in the background.
Caroline painted her tree-and-sun artwork after visiting an LGBTQ+ center. She wanted the painting to capture the unity and strength of the people there.
Melanie praised Caroline's painting as gorgeous, saying its colors were vivid, its composition unified, and that it conveyed unity and strength.
Melanie and her children had just finished another painting similar to their previous one.

On 2023-07-18, Caroline joined a new LGBTQ+ activist group called Connected LGBTQ Activists. The group includes people working for positive change, holds regular meetings, plans events and campaigns, and supports its members. Caroline said joining was fulfilling and let her speak up for LGBTQ+ rights and community support.

Caroline feels that being part of Connected LGBTQ Activists gives members a platform to be themselves and support other people's rights. She finds the experience fulfilling and believes change is possible through collective action.

A pride parade took place in Caroline's city during the weekend of 2023-07-15 to 2023-07-16. People marched through the streets with flags and signs to celebrate love and diversity. Caroline missed the parade, but said it reminded her that LGBTQ+ people are not alone in the fight for equality and inclusion.
Melanie recently took her children to the beach, where the children had a great time. Melanie shared a photo showing three children playing on the beach with a kite.
Caroline asked Melanie what the best part of the recent beach outing was and whether Melanie often takes her children to the beach.

Melanie said she and her children usually go to the beach only once or twice a year, and those visits are special opportunities to spend time together and relax. Melanie said seeing her children so happy at the beach was the best part. She shared a photo of a sandcastle on a beach beneath a blue sky.

Melanie’s family looks forward to an annual summer camping trip. They roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire, and enjoy each other’s company; Melanie described the trip as the highlight of their summer. Melanie shared a photo of a fire pit with a large fire and many sparks.

Melanie’s favorite camping memory is her family’s camping trip in 2022, when they watched the Perseid meteor shower. They lay watching streaks of light across the sky, made wishes, and felt at one with the universe. Melanie said she would never forget the memory. She shared a photo depicting a plane flying across a star-filled sky.

Caroline and Melanie are friends or acquaintances who address each other by name; Caroline calls Melanie “Mel” (and once “Mell”). They value their friendship and mutual support. Caroline values LGBTQ+ support and is exploring counseling or mental-health work, especially supporting trans people, to help people with experiences like hers and create a safe, inviting space. Counseling, her journey, and support groups improved Caroline’s life and self-understanding. Caroline is researching adoption and dreams of giving children in need a loving home; on 2023-05-25 she chose an unnamed agency for LGBTQ+ inclusivity and support. On 2023-07-14 Caroline attended an inspiring, emotional adoption council meeting and felt more determined to adopt. On 2023-07-18 Caroline joined Connected LGBTQ Activist. Melanie has children; her family usually visits the beach once or twice yearly and has an annual summer camping trip. In 2022, Melanie’s family watched the Perseid meteor shower while camping.

On 2023-07-20, Melanie described seeing a clear, star-filled sky and an amazing meteor shower, which made her feel part of something huge and awe-inspiring. The shared photo showed a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke behind it.
On 2023-07-20, Melanie said the meteor-shower experience made her feel tiny and in awe of the universe, and reminded her how awesome life is and how meaningful little moments can be.

Melanie said she would never forget the day her youngest daughter took her first steps. Watching her daughter wobble through those first steps reminded Melanie how fleeting life is and how lucky she is to share such moments.
On 2023-07-20, Caroline shared a photo of a baby in a white crib with a blue blanket while responding warmly to Melanie's story about her youngest daughter's first steps.
Melanie said that special moments with her family make her appreciate life and feel lucky to share her family's love. She shared a photo of a family standing on a beach at sunset.
Caroline called Melanie's family moment beautiful and said Melanie was lucky to have such an awesome family. Melanie replied that she feels lucky because her family brings her joy and love.

On 2023-08-13, Melanie celebrated her daughter's birthday at a concert with her children. Melanie described the evening as amazing, with music, joy, a warm summer breeze, and happy smiles from her children; she felt thankful for their special moments together.

Melanie attended a concert by Matt Patterson for her daughter's birthday on 2023-08-13. Melanie praised Matt Patterson's talent, voice, and songs. Caroline shared a photo of a concert poster showing a man.

Caroline attended a pride parade on 2023-08-11. She found it full of energy and love, felt proud, and was reminded of the importance of standing up for equality. Caroline shared a photo of a group walking down a street with balloons.
Melanie shared a photo of a band performing on a stage beside a sign reading “all are welcome.”
Caroline found attending the pride parade inspiring. Seeing people of different backgrounds celebrating love and acceptance encouraged her to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
Melanie believes it is important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for her children.
Melanie shared a photo of a group of people sitting on chairs and watching a band; Melanie said the photo was from the previous night, 2023-08-13.
Caroline considers representing inclusivity and diversity in her art important. She also uses her art to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and promote acceptance.
Caroline shared a photo of a recent painting, with a paintbrush and paint visible.

On 2023-08-14, Caroline said her art expresses her trans experience, tells her story, and helps people understand the trans community. A shared photo showed a painting of a woman with a cow in her lap.
On 2023-08-14, Melanie praised Caroline’s art and shared a photo showing a person holding a purple bowl.

On 2023-08-14, Caroline shared her painting titled “Embracing Identity.” Caroline said it is about finding comfort and love in being oneself; the woman in the painting represents the journey of acceptance, and Caroline aimed to convey warmth, love, and self-acceptance. The shared photo showed a painting of a woman wearing a red shirt.
On 2023-08-14, Melanie shared a photo showing a woman making a vase on a pottery wheel and asked Caroline how art supports her self-discovery and acceptance.
Caroline said art helps her explore her transition and changing body and work through what she is experiencing. She also said art teaches her to accept the beauty of imperfections.

Melanie described art as healing and as a way to connect with oneself, and said everyone is individual and wonderfully imperfect. Melanie thanked Caroline for sharing her art and story; Caroline said sharing with Melanie meant a lot to her.
On August 14, 2023, Melanie told Caroline, “Great chatting with you! Feel free to reach out any time,” expressing openness to future contact.

On 2023-08-17, Caroline told Melanie that she had recently had a distressing experience while hiking, where a group of religious conservatives said something that upset her. The experience reminded Caroline that more work is needed for LGBTQ+ rights. Caroline said having accepting, supportive people around her helped her feel she would be okay.
On 2023-08-17, Melanie showed Caroline a photo of a bowl Melanie had made, decorated with a colorful design and patterns. Melanie said she was proud of the project and had enjoyed making it.

Melanie said she is obsessed with colorful designs and patterns and made her pottery bowl to catch the eye and make people smile. She said painting helps her express her feelings and creativity, with each brushstroke carrying a part of her.

Melanie said she has always felt strongly connected to art, which has been a major learning experience and serves as both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. Art brings Melanie happiness and fulfillment.

Caroline praised Melanie's pottery bowl, effort, passion, and creativity, and said Melanie's use of art for self-expression and growth was inspiring. Caroline was glad Melanie had found something that made her happy.

Caroline and Melanie agreed that life can be difficult but is worth it when they have things that bring them happiness. Caroline said holding onto happy moments helps people keep going through hard times; both described each other as making life's struggles more bearable.

On 2023-08-17, Caroline and Melanie expressed appreciation for their friendship. Caroline told Melanie she was in her corner and always available to support her; Melanie said Caroline had always been there for her.

Caroline recalled that she and Melanie had a great time at a Pride festival in 2022. Caroline shared a photo showing a group of people walking down a street with balloons, which she associated with their supportive friends and the Pride festival.

On 2023-08-17, Melanie and Caroline reminisced that an outing with their whole group had been a blast and discussed having another outing during the summer. Melanie suggested a family outing; Caroline also suggested planning something special for just the two of them, to catch up and explore nature. Melanie agreed to plan something special, and Caroline looked forward to making memories on the trip.

On 2023-08-23, Caroline told Melanie that she had taken the first step toward becoming a mother by applying to adoption agencies. Caroline said she felt excited but somewhat nervous because parenting is a major responsibility, and that an adoption advice and assistance group she attended had been very helpful.
Caroline has a male guinea pig named Oscar. On 2023-08-23, Caroline shared a photo of Oscar eating parsley in a cage with hay, and said vegetables are Oscar's favorite.
On 2023-08-23, Caroline shared a photo of a sign featuring a guinea pig while telling Melanie about applying to adoption agencies.

Melanie said she had pets and that they were doing well; Melanie said they had also gotten another cat named Bailey. Melanie shared a photo described as Oliver, showing a black dog lying in grass with a frisbee. Oliver once hid his bone in Melanie's slipper. The conversation does not clearly establish Oliver's species.
Melanie recalled that she once fed a horse a carrot and shared a photo of a person holding a carrot in front of a horse.
On 2023-08-23, Melanie congratulated Caroline on applying to adoption agencies, expressed pride in her, and asked how she felt. Caroline thanked Melanie and called her “Mel.”
Caroline said that as a child she went horseback riding with her father through fields, felt the wind, and found the experience special; she has always loved horses.
On 2023-08-23, Melanie shared a photo of her painting of a horse on a wooden wall. Melanie said she loves painting animals because it feels peaceful and special, and admired horses' grace.

On 2023-08-23, Caroline shared a photo of a recent self-portrait she had made the previous week: a painting of a woman with a blue face. Caroline said painting helps her express herself, explore her identity, and be true to herself; she felt liberated and empowered while making the portrait and finds painting therapeutic.
Caroline loves creating art and finds painting a way to express herself and a source of freedom.
